name: DNS Changer
author: HACK3RRABBIT
description: Switch your system DNS from the Omarchy bar. Pick from a curated, ping-sorted server list (Shecan, Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, gaming and anti-sanction DNS, ...) with live ping and provider icons, save your own named custom DNS profiles, connect to a one-off address, go random, or disconnect back to the defaults. A faithful Omarchy port of the DNS Changer CLI/desktop app.

barWidget.description: Switch system DNS servers from the bar
